LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.label: forest bloodline
LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.description: An inherited bond with the forest's old magic. Carriers hold mana, learn their own kind of casting, and can wake a spellbook that is dead in anyone else's hands. The bond also raises how much neural heat the body can bear.
LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.resourceDescription: The caster's own reserve. A spell spends it when it resolves; the maximum is set by the bloodline level and can be raised further by a spellbook or a staff.
